name: Wfuzz
description: Wfuzz is a tool designed for web application security testing. It can be used for various tasks like brute-force attacking web forms, discovering hidden resources, and testing for vulnerabilities.

inputs.label: Target URL:
inputs.help: The target URL with the FUZZ keyword to indicate where the payload will be injected.

inputs.label: Wordlist Path (-z file):
inputs.help: Path to the wordlist file to be used for fuzzing.

inputs.label: Upload Wordlist File:
inputs.help: Upload a wordlist file to be used for fuzzing.

inputs.label: POST Data (-d):
inputs.help: Data to send with a POST request. Use FUZZ to specify injection points.

inputs.label: Proxy (-p):
inputs.help: Use an HTTP/SOCKS proxy.

inputs.label: Threads (-t):
inputs.help: Number of concurrent connections.

inputs.label: Delay (-c):
inputs.help: Delay between requests in milliseconds.

inputs.label: Hide Status Codes (--hc):
inputs.help: Hide responses with these status codes.

inputs.label: Hide by Size (--hs):
inputs.help: Hide responses with a specific size.

inputs.label: Hide by Lines (--hl):
inputs.help: Hide responses with a specific number of lines.

inputs.label: Hide by Chars (--hw):
inputs.help: Hide responses with a specific number of characters.

inputs.label: Filter by String (--fs):
inputs.help: Filter responses by a specific string.

inputs.label: Word Mode
inputs.help: Wfuzz word mode.

inputs.label: Request File Path (-r):
inputs.help: Load a full HTTP request from a file.

inputs.label: Upload Request File:
inputs.help: Upload a file containing a raw HTTP request.

inputs.label: Cookie (-b):
inputs.help: Specify a cookie for the requests.

inputs.label: User-Agent (-H):
inputs.help: Specify a custom User-Agent header.

inputs.label: Follow Redirects (-L)
inputs.help: Follow HTTP redirects.

inputs.label: Recursive (-R)
inputs.help: Follow redirects and try to find more URLs.

inputs.label: Output File Path (-o):
inputs.help: Save the output to a file.

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.help: Any other wfuzz arguments not covered by the GUI. Enter them exactly as you would on the command line.
